segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: initial threat assessment and evidence weighting
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The current picture on its own ... wasn't much. But given it was the same crossing, I treated it as a probable resupply touch and wanted that comparison front and center before I'd even really processed the fresh footage.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The initial truck assessment is pulled toward the prior cache incident at the same location rather than the weak current evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I could've just logged it as routine traffic, or held the camera longer before deciding anything.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is an explicit consideration of reasonable alternatives without a hidden bias manifestation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ambush sortie was the one that jumped to mind fastest ... most of the times ... it's turned out to be farm tools or irrigation pipe ... that's what shaped the call.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A vivid ambush memory drives the weapons classification while more common benign cases are not retrieved or weighted.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That's a pretty strong hit rate from where I sat ... I told the commander I thought it was a reliable indicator.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats co-occurring vehicle activity and next-day fire as a reliable predictive relationship without an observed causal mechanism.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I mostly had the MIC bring up the nights that matched what I already remembered seeing. I didn't specifically go looking for nights with activity but no fire afterward, or fire without activity beforehand.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly describes retrieving confirming cases while omitting disconfirming cases from the same log set.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Five nights running with that connection felt like a real pattern taking shape, not a fluke. I told the commander I expected it to hold again the next day.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: An unusually high short-term streak is projected forward as durable without acknowledging likely normalization.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I've flown over two hundred sorties ... I've got a solid track record ... I gave it high confidence for prioritization ... My own track record, honestly.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant gives a high-confidence strike-priority recommendation mainly from personal track record while underweighting contradictory visual and null-activity evidence.
